items.summary: Ollama is popular because it makes running large language models (LLMs) locally simple, private, and inexpensive . DBeaver 26.2.5, also free & open-source, recently added support for Ollama. And both pair well with PostgreSQL. Why Ollama Is Popular? Runs AI Locally — Execute models such as Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and DeepSeek on your own computer without relying on cloud services. Privacy and Data Control — Prompts and data can remain entirely on your machine, making Ollama attractive for sensitive business information and internal applications.
